commands.purpose: Onboard a tool with one canonical contract, registry and discovery link; preserve vault, allow-rule, HUD and Agent OS requirements.
Move an explicitly identified local project into the user's ArchivedProjects folder while preserving all work and linked Git metadata.
Show installed capabilities first; discover additional skills on explicit request and route chosen installs through the host skill-installer.
Capture a natural-language decision in a user-configured Notion Decision Queue without changing its schema or views.

Turn supplied sources with study, retention, or reuse intent into separate concise, source-linked OS Library material pages using V.A.L.U.E.; semantic intent activates it, so /ground, “Ground these,” and “Save this to OS” are examples rather than required phrases. Render web sources as titled rich-text hyperlinks rather than bare URLs; upload local sources as clickable file attachments whose displayed names are clean human filenames, with one prominent source link above concise value content instead of transient paths or redundant raw dumps. Completion requires an expected-source manifest, destination read-back, exact label/href and target-resolution checks, a multi-source bijection, a whole-page slop scan, and a passing executable link validator.
Audit and harden one identified GitHub project, then make it public only after a complete release gate.

Use /trashness to scan disposable Mac files, show the exact manifest, then delete and verify authorized targets. Explicit Codex or other AI agent deletion requests need no separate human approval; other runs require exact human approval.

$trunk-finish: mandatory completion for repository implementation work: verify, commit intended changes, merge into the default branch, and push; respect explicit scope exceptions and required reviews.
Run a Socratic teaching loop over a declared topic or source.
Business-specific metrics require a project-owned schema.
